data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by an HTTP 400 API error in the first model (qwen3-235b) when attempting to audit shutter-encoder.sh, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict. The second model (deepseek-v4-flash) successfully audited the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review shutter-encoder.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) during file audits to prevent a single transient or malformed request from causing an overall inconclusive package verdict.
